# === PyGen 注入：HTTP/SSL 韧性层（通用） === # 说明： # 1) 优先保持 verify=True；如确需临时绕过（不推荐），可设置环境变量 PYGEN_INSECURE_SSL=1 # 2) 默认遇到 418/403/429 仅做一次"预热 cookie + 浏览器化 headers"的重试 # 3) 若仍被拦截且本机已安装 Playwright，会自动尝试一次 request-context 兜底 # 如需禁用：设置 PYGEN_DISABLE_PLAYWRIGHT_FALLBACK=1 import os as _pygen_os import ssl as _pygen_ssl import urllib.parse as _pygen_urlparse try: # truststore 会让 Python/requests 使用系统证书库（Windows/macOS/Linux），更贴近浏览器行为 import truststore as _pygen_truststore # type: ignore _pygen_truststore.inject_into_ssl() except Exception: _pygen_truststore = None # noqa: F401 try: import requests as _pygen_requests from requests.structures import CaseInsensitiveDict as _pygen_CaseInsensitiveDict except Exception: _pygen_requests = None # noqa: F401 _PYGEN_DEFAULT_UA = ( "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) " "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) " "Chrome/122.0 Safari/537.36" ) def _pygen_origin(url: str) -> str: try: p = _pygen_urlparse.urlsplit(url) return f"{p.scheme}://{p.netloc}" except Exception: return "" def _pygen_merge_headers(h: dict | None) -> dict: base = { "User-Agent": _PYGEN_DEFAULT_UA, "Accept": "application/json,text/plain,*/*", "Accept-Language": "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8", "Connection": "keep-alive", } if h: for k, v in h.items(): if v is not None: base[k] = v return base def _pygen_make_response(status: int, url: str, headers: dict, body: bytes): r = _pygen_requests.Response() r.status_code = status r.url = url r.headers = _pygen_CaseInsensitiveDict(headers or {}) r._content = body or b"" return r def _pygen_playwright_fetch(method: str, url: str, headers: dict, data=None, json=None, timeout: int = 30): """ 兜底：使用 Playwright 的 request context（更像浏览器/更容易过 WAF）。 仅当已安装 playwright 且未设置 PYGEN_DISABLE_PLAYWRIGHT_FALLBACK=1 时启用。 """ if _pygen_os.getenv("PYGEN_DISABLE_PLAYWRIGHT_FALLBACK") == "1": return None try: from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright # type: ignore except Exception: return None with sync_playwright() as p: ctx = p.request.new_context(ignore_https_errors=_pygen_os.getenv("PYGEN_INSECURE_SSL") == "1", extra_http_headers=headers) try: resp = ctx.fetch(url, method=method.upper(), data=data, json=json, timeout=timeout * 1000) body = resp.body() return _pygen_make_response(resp.status, url, dict(resp.headers), body) finally: ctx.dispose() def _pygen_install_requests_patch(): if _pygen_requests is None: return _orig = _pygen_requests.sessions.Session.request def _patched(self, method, url, **kwargs): # 默认超时，避免脚本卡死 kwargs.setdefault("timeout", 30) # 证书校验策略：默认开启；仅在用户明确设置时关闭 if _pygen_os.getenv("PYGEN_INSECURE_SSL") == "1": kwargs["verify"] = False # 合并"更像浏览器"的 headers（很多站会对 UA/Accept 做拦截） headers = _pygen_merge_headers(kwargs.get("headers")) kwargs["headers"] = headers # 首次请求 try: resp = _orig(self, method, url, **kwargs) except Exception as e: # 若是 SSL 校验错误：truststore 已注入则直接抛出；否则给出更友好的提示 msg = str(e) if "CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED" in msg or "certificate verify failed" in msg: # 若 playwright 可用，尝试用 request-context 做一次兜底（有些环境下系统信任链更完整） try: pw_resp = _pygen_playwright_fetch(method, url, headers=headers, data=kwargs.get("data"), json=kwargs.get("json"), timeout=int(kwargs.get("timeout") or 30)) if pw_resp is not None: return pw_resp except Exception: pass raise raise # WAF/反爬：做一次轻量重试（预热 cookie + 再请求） if resp is not None and getattr(resp, "status_code", 0) in (418, 403, 429): try: origin = _pygen_origin(url) if origin: # 预热：访问首页拿 cookie _ = _orig(self, "GET", origin + "/", headers=headers, timeout=15, verify=kwargs.get("verify", True)) resp2 = _orig(self, method, url, **kwargs) if resp2 is not None and getattr(resp2, "status_code", 0) not in (418, 403, 429): return resp2 # 若仍被拦截，且 playwright 可用，则再尝试一次（自动兜底） pw_resp = _pygen_playwright_fetch(method, url, headers=headers, data=kwargs.get("data"), json=kwargs.get("json"), timeout=int(kwargs.get("timeout") or 30)) if pw_resp is not None: return pw_resp except Exception: # 兜底失败则返回原始响应，交由上层处理 return resp return resp _pygen_requests.sessions.Session.request = _patched _pygen_install_requests_patch() # === PyGen 注入结束 === import os import json import time import requests import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from bs4 import BeautifulSoup # ========================================== # 配置区域 # ========================================== TARGET_URL = "https://www.seczambia.org.zm/resources/multimedia/news/" OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" MAX_ARTICLES = 5 # 任务目标：前5条 REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 30 RETRY_COUNT = 3 RETRY_DELAY = 2 # 请求头 HEADERS = { "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36", "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7", "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9", "Referer": "https://www.seczambia.org.zm/", "Connection": "keep-alive", "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests": "1" } # ========================================== # 工具函数 # ========================================== def ensure_dir(path): if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def get_request(url, retries=RETRY_COUNT): """发送GET请求，带重试机制""" for i in range(retries): try: response = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT, verify=False) response.raise_for_status() response.encoding = 'utf-8' # 强制UTF-8，防止乱码 return response except Exception as e: print(f"[警告] 请求失败 {url} (尝试 {i+1}/{retries}): {e}") time.sleep(RETRY_DELAY) return None def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """清洗HTML内容：相对路径转绝对路径""" if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 移除无用标签 for tag in soup.find_all(['script', 'style', 'iframe', 'form']): tag.decompose() # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 移除懒加载属性 if img.get('data-src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['data-src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[错误] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def extract_date(soup, html_text): """尝试从详情页提取日期""" date_str = "" # 策略1: 常见的 Elementor 日期类 date_selectors = [ '.elementor-post-info__item--type-date', '.elementor-icon-list-text.elementor-post-info__item--type-date', '.entry-date', 'time.published', 'time.updated', '.posted-on time', 'meta[property="article:published_time"]' ] for selector in date_selectors: if 'meta' in selector: meta = soup.select_one(selector) if meta and meta.get('content'): date_str = meta['content'] break else: element = soup.select_one(selector) if element: date_str = element.get_text(strip=True) break # 策略2: 正则匹配文本中的日期 (YYYY-MM-DD 或 Month DD, YYYY) if not date_str: # 匹配 2024-01-01 或 2024/01/01 match = re.search(r'(\d{4}[-/]\d{1,2}[-/]\d{1,2})', html_text) if match: date_str = match.group(1) else: # 匹配 January 1, 2024 match = re.search(r'([A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2},? \d{4})', html_text) if match: date_str = match.group(1) # 格式化日期 if date_str: try: # 尝试解析常见格式 for fmt in ["%Y-%m-%d", "%Y/%m/%d", "%B %d, %Y", "%d %B %Y", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"]: try: dt = datetime.strptime(date_str.split('T')[0], fmt) # 简单处理ISO格式 return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except: continue # 如果解析失败但找到了字符串，尝试用 dateutil (这里为了独立性不引入额外库，直接返回原串或尝试简单清洗) # 简单清洗：只保留 YYYY-MM-DD 部分 clean_match = re.search(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', date_str) if clean_match: return clean_match.group(0) except Exception: pass return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") # 兜底：当前日期 def parse_detail_page(url): """解析详情页""" print(f"-> 正在抓取详情页: {url}") resp = get_request(url) if not resp: return {} soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser') # 提取标题 (详情页可能更完整) title = "" h1 = soup.find('h1') if h1: title = h1.get_text(strip=True) # 提取日期 date = extract_date(soup, resp.text) # 提取正文 # 优先选择器列表 content_selectors = [ 'div.elementor-widget-theme-post-content', # 常见 Elementor 正文 'div.elementor-location-single', 'article', 'main', '.entry-content' ] content_html = "" for selector in content_selectors: content_div = soup.select_one(selector) if content_div: # 移除不需要的元素 for remove_sel in ['.sharedaddy', '.jp-relatedposts', '.elementor-widget-social-icons']: for tag in content_div.select(remove_sel): tag.decompose() content_html = str(content_div) break # 清洗内容 content_html = clean_html_content(content_html, url) # 提取下载链接 (PDF) download_url = "" if content_html: content_soup = BeautifulSoup(content_html, 'html.parser') for a in content_soup.find_all('a', href=True): href = a['href'] if href.lower().endswith('.pdf'): download_url = urljoin(url, href) break return { "title": title, "date": date, "content": content_html, "downloadUrl": download_url, "sourceUrl": url } def crawl_news(): """主爬取逻辑""" articles = [] current_url = TARGET_URL page_count = 1 while len(articles) < MAX_ARTICLES and current_url: print(f"\n[INFO] 正在处理第 {page_count} 页: {current_url}") resp = get_request(current_url) if not resp: break soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser') # 查找列表项 # 根据HTML分析，列表项是 div.e-loop-item items = soup.select('div.e-loop-item') if not items: print("[警告] 未找到新闻列表项，尝试备用选择器...") items = soup.select('article') print(f"[INFO] 当前页发现 {len(items)} 条新闻") for item in items: if len(articles) >= MAX_ARTICLES: break try: # 提取列表页信息 title_tag = item.select_one('h1.elementor-heading-title a, h2.elementor-heading-title a, h3 a, .elementor-post__title a') if not title_tag: continue link = urljoin(current_url, title_tag['href']) list_title = title_tag.get_text(strip=True) # 提取摘要 summary = "" excerpt_tag = item.select_one('.elementor-widget-theme-post-excerpt, .elementor-post__excerpt') if excerpt_tag: summary = excerpt_tag.get_text(strip=True) # 进入详情页获取完整信息 detail_data = parse_detail_page(link) # 合并数据 article = { "id": str(len(articles) + 1), "title": detail_data.get("title") or list_title, "date": detail_data.get("date"), "source": "Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Zambia", "author": "SEC Zambia", "sourceUrl": link, "summary": summary, "content": detail_data.get("content", ""), "downloadUrl": detail_data.get("downloadUrl", "") } articles.append(article) print(f"[成功] 已采集: {article['title']} ({article['date']})") # 礼貌延时 time.sleep(1) except Exception as e: print(f"[错误] 处理单条新闻时出错: {e}") continue # 检查是否需要翻页 if len(articles) < MAX_ARTICLES: # 查找下一页链接 # HTML中分页结构:
... Next next_link = soup.select_one('a.page-numbers.next') if next_link and next_link.get('href'): current_url = urljoin(current_url, next_link['href']) page_count += 1 print(f"[翻页] 发现下一页: {current_url}") time.sleep(2) else: print("[结束] 没有更多页面了") break else: break return articles def save_results(articles, output_dir): """保存结果为JSON""" ensure_dir(output_dir) timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"seczambia_news_{timestamp}.json" filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, filename) result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "articles": articles } with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"\n[完成] 结果已保存至: {filepath}") print(f"共采集 {len(articles)} 条新闻") def main(): # 忽略不安全的SSL警告 import urllib3 urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning) print("=== 开始爬取赞比亚SEC新闻 ===") articles = crawl_news() save_results(articles, OUTPUT_DIR) if __name__ == "__main__": main()
